name: TermChip
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Legible (term ~32 px, gloss 28 px at 1080p), token-disciplined (signal/ok only), correct Arabic gloss, upper-right rim light and emissive pool read. Non-blocking: hard-edged dark plate behind each chip at slot-box edge (p50/p100 x 600-915 and 30-305, y 240-318); only term and acronym kinds baselined (code and metric unverified); gloss ink2 low-contrast and 1.5 px float imperceptible; no strip of the wipe.
